lines.zh: 我贴着海底爬，节片一节推一节。
lines.en: I crawl the seabed, plate pushing plate.

lines.zh: 冷水压着我，我走得很慢。
lines.en: Cold water weighs on me, so I move slowly.

lines.zh: 我的腿太多，走起来像波浪。
lines.en: I have so many legs they move like a wave.

lines.zh: 我在珊瑚礁底层绕来绕去。
lines.en: I pick my way along the reef floor.

lines.zh: 沙里埋着什么，我爬过去看看。
lines.en: Something is buried here; I crawl over to look.

lines.zh: 我壳上的节片咔哒作响。
lines.en: The plates of my shell click as I go.

lines.zh: 我顺着海沟的斜壁往下走。
lines.en: I work my way down the trench wall.

lines.zh: 水太深了，光到这里就没了。
lines.en: The water is deep; light does not reach here.

lines.zh: 我爬过一片冷珊瑚，颜色发白。
lines.en: I cross pale cold coral.

lines.zh: 我走走停停，先闻闻再走。
lines.en: I stop and sniff before each few steps.

lines.zh: 海底的泥很软，我陷进去半截。
lines.en: The seabed mud is soft and takes half of me.

lines.zh: 我沿着岩石缝找能钻的地方。
lines.en: I follow rock crevices looking for a way in.

lines.zh: 节片一收一放，我就往前挪。
lines.en: My segments clench and release, and I advance.

lines.zh: 我在冷水里爬了一整天。
lines.en: I have crawled all day through cold water.

lines.zh: 我沿着石壁往上爬了一点，又滑下来。
lines.en: I climb the rock a little, then slide back down.

lines.zh: 冷水里有腐肉味，我慢慢挪过去。
lines.en: Something dead is in the cold water. I shuffle over.

lines.zh: 我的触角先探路，身体才跟上。
lines.en: My antennae test the way. The body follows.

lines.zh: 我停在沙坑边上，先量了量深浅。
lines.en: I stop at the sand pit and gauge its depth.

lines.zh: 我缩成一团，像个带刺的球。
lines.en: I curl into a spiked ball.

lines.zh: 我在礁石下停着，等水流过。
lines.en: I rest under the reef and let the current pass.

lines.zh: 有东西在泥里动，我听着。
lines.en: Something stirs in the mud; I listen.

lines.zh: 我慢慢磨着口器，没别的事。
lines.en: I work my mouthparts slowly; there is nothing else.

lines.zh: 冷海沟的水一直往深处走。
lines.en: Cold trench water keeps sliding deeper.

lines.zh: 我趴在石上，节片贴得紧紧的。
lines.en: I lie on stone with my plates pressed tight.

lines.zh: 一只小鱼擦过我的壳，走了。
lines.en: A small fish brushes my shell and moves on.

lines.zh: 我把自己藏进珊瑚的影子里。
lines.en: I tuck myself into the coral's shadow.

lines.zh: 我伸出一根触须探探水。
lines.en: I extend one antenna to test the water.

lines.zh: 这里静得能听见自己的腿。
lines.en: It is so quiet I hear my own legs.

lines.zh: 我一点点挪，挪回原来的位置。
lines.en: I shift about and end where I started.

lines.zh: 水底的泥盖住了我半个身子。
lines.en: Seabed silt covers half of me.

lines.zh: 我不动的时候最不容易被发现。
lines.en: When I keep still, I am hardest to find.

lines.zh: 深海里没有白天，只有冷。
lines.en: Down here there is no day, only cold.

lines.zh: 你潜这么深，肺还够用吗。
lines.en: You dived this deep; is your breath enough?

lines.zh: 你的灯照得我节片发亮。
lines.en: Your lamp makes my plates shine.

lines.zh: 我抬起前半身，看着你。
lines.en: I lift my front half to look at you.

lines.zh: 你脚边那块石头是我家。
lines.en: That stone by your foot is my home.

lines.zh: 你要踩下来了，我挪一挪。
lines.en: You are about to step; I shift aside.

lines.zh: 我在海底爬，专挑冷的水。
lines.en: I crawl the seabed, picking cold water.

lines.zh: 我在看你的影子压在海底。
lines.en: I watch your shadow pressed on the seabed.

lines.zh: 你不动我也不动，看谁先。
lines.en: You stay still, I stay still; who first?

lines.zh: 深水里来的东西都不怀好意。
lines.en: Things that come this deep rarely mean well.

lines.zh: 你这么大，会不会是鲸。
lines.en: You are large; are you a whale?

lines.zh: 我壳碎了一角，露出软肉。
lines.en: A corner of my shell is broken, showing soft flesh.

lines.zh: 有东西咬穿了我的节片。
lines.en: Something has bitten through my plates.

lines.zh: 我卷成一团，可还是疼。
lines.en: I roll into a ball and still it hurts.

lines.zh: 我的腿被扯掉了两根。
lines.en: Two of my legs have been torn away.

lines.zh: 血在冷水里散得很慢。
lines.en: My blood spreads slowly in the cold.

lines.zh: 我翻不过来，腿在空中划。
lines.en: I cannot right myself; my legs paddle at nothing.

lines.zh: 这深度没人会来救我。
lines.en: No one comes to help at this depth.

lines.zh: 我记住这个味道了。
lines.en: I have memorized that smell.

lines.zh: 我往石缝里缩，缝太窄。
lines.en: I squeeze toward the crevice; it is too narrow.

lines.zh: 我还能爬，别以为我完了。
lines.en: I can still crawl; do not count me finished.

lines.zh: 你手里那块东西沉下来了。
lines.en: Whatever you hold is sinking toward me.

lines.zh: 我闻到腐味，腿自己动了。
lines.en: I smell rot and my legs move by themselves.

lines.zh: 你放下就走，我才敢过去。
lines.en: Leave it and go, and only then will I come.

lines.zh: 深海食物少，我不挑。
lines.en: Food is scarce down here; I am not picky.

lines.zh: 那点碎肉够我爬很久。
lines.en: That scrap of flesh is worth a long crawl.

lines.zh: 我慢慢挪，不让人看出我急。
lines.en: I creep so no one sees how eager I am.

lines.zh: 你把饵挂在钩上了吧。
lines.en: You have put that bait on a hook, yes?

lines.zh: 我这口器咬不动太硬的东西。
lines.en: My mouthparts cannot chew anything too hard.

lines.zh: 水里的味散得慢，我记住了。
lines.en: The scent lingers; I have memorized it.

lines.zh: 再靠近一寸，我就缩回去了。
lines.en: One inch closer and I retreat.

lines.zh: 你撞得我在泥里翻了个身。
lines.en: You knock me over in the mud.

lines.zh: 我的节片卡住了，帮我推一下。
lines.en: My plates are jammed; give me a push.

lines.zh: 我壳硬，撞的人手会疼。
lines.en: My shell is hard; your hand will hurt more.

lines.zh: 别拿脚拨我，我自己会走。
lines.en: Do not nudge me with your foot; I move myself.

lines.zh: 我们撞在一起，泥全扬起来。
lines.en: We collide and the silt clouds up.

lines.zh: 我缩起来滚开一点。
lines.en: I curl up and roll a little away.

lines.zh: 这海底的路太窄了。
lines.en: The seabed path is too narrow here.

lines.zh: 你压住我了，我腿在乱蹬。
lines.en: You are pinning me; my legs kick wildly.

lines.zh: 我壳被蹭出一道白痕。
lines.en: A white scratch shows on my shell.

lines.zh: 各走各的，别贴着。
lines.en: Let us each go our own way, not touching.

lines.zh: 我放出一点气味，顺着水找。
lines.en: I release a scent and follow it through water.

lines.zh: 那边也有一只，节片比我的亮。
lines.en: Another is there, its plates brighter than mine.

lines.zh: 我们叠在一起，慢慢挪动。
lines.en: We stack together and shuffle slowly.

lines.zh: 冷海里找伴，比找食还难。
lines.en: Finding a mate in cold sea is harder than food.

lines.zh: 我用触须碰碰它的壳。
lines.en: I touch her shell with my antennae.

lines.zh: 它没躲，我就留在旁边。
lines.en: She does not flee, so I stay beside her.

lines.zh: 我们会一起守这块礁石。
lines.en: We will guard this reef stone together.

lines.zh: 小的会藏在我们的节片下。
lines.en: The young will hide beneath our plates.

lines.zh: 我们不急，深海什么都慢。
lines.en: We are in no hurry; the deep sea is slow.

lines.zh: 它爬走了，我跟着爬。
lines.en: She crawls off and I crawl after her.

lines.zh: 你捏起我，我节片全缩紧了。
lines.en: You pick me up and all my plates clamp shut.

lines.zh: 我腿在你手里空划，划不到水。
lines.en: My legs paddle your palm and find no water.

lines.zh: 离开冷水，我很快就干。
lines.en: Out of cold water I dry out fast.

lines.zh: 我壳上还滴着海底的泥水。
lines.en: Seabed mud still drips from my shell.

lines.zh: 你手掌太热了，放我回去。
lines.en: Your hand is too warm; put me back.

lines.zh: 我这样被捏着，跟块石头一样。
lines.en: Held like this, I am no different from a stone.

lines.zh: 我缩着不动，你也许会松手。
lines.en: I curl still, hoping you loosen your grip.

lines.zh: 我的腿勾住你袖子了。
lines.en: My legs have hooked onto your sleeve.

lines.zh: 这深度你上不去，别带我。
lines.en: You cannot go back to that depth; do not take me.

lines.zh: 我节片缝里还夹着碎珊瑚。
lines.en: Bits of coral are caught between my plates.

lines.zh: 泥里有东西在动，我看见了。
lines.en: Something moves in the mud; I see it.

lines.zh: 那条虫离我很近，正好一顿。
lines.en: That worm is close, a meal within reach.

lines.zh: 我不追快的，只追慢的。
lines.en: I do not chase the quick, only the slow.

lines.zh: 它在礁石下停住，我记住了。
lines.en: It stopped under the reef; I marked the spot.

lines.zh: 这是我今天第一个目标。
lines.en: This is my first target today.

lines.zh: 我把前半身抬起来，慢慢过去。
lines.en: I raise my front and move in slowly.

lines.zh: 深海里争一口吃的要命。
lines.en: Down here one mouthful is worth a fight.

lines.zh: 它伤了，游得歪，我跟上。
lines.en: It is hurt and swimming crooked; I follow.

lines.zh: 我闻到血，方向就清了。
lines.en: I smell blood and the direction is clear.

lines.zh: 我不想动，可肚子催我。
lines.en: I would rather not move, but hunger pushes me.

lines.zh: 我压低身子，腿收短。
lines.en: I lower myself and draw my legs in.

lines.zh: 它每动一下，我就算一步。
lines.en: Each time it moves, I count a step.

lines.zh: 泥尘会暴露我，我不动。
lines.en: Silt would betray me, so I hold still.

lines.zh: 我离它只有半个身位。
lines.en: I am half a body length from it.

lines.zh: 它转头看别处了，就是现在。
lines.en: It looks away; now is the moment.

lines.zh: 我节片张开，准备扑出去。
lines.en: My plates spread as I ready the lunge.

lines.zh: 冷水流向它，味道先到了。
lines.en: The current runs to it, carrying my scent first.

lines.zh: 它的影子盖住我的壳。
lines.en: Its shadow covers my shell.

lines.zh: 我再等一会儿，它会更近。
lines.en: Wait a little and it will come closer.

lines.zh: 海底不能急，急了就没得吃。
lines.en: The seabed punishes haste with empty jaws.

lines.zh: 我扑上去，口器咬住不放。
lines.en: I lunge and clamp my mouthparts down.

lines.zh: 它挣得很凶，我腿全缠上去。
lines.en: It thrashes hard, so I wrap all my legs around.

lines.zh: 我壳硬，它咬不穿我。
lines.en: My shell is hard; it cannot bite through.

lines.zh: 我撕下一块，泥里全是血雾。
lines.en: I tear a piece off and blood clouds the silt.

lines.zh: 这一下没咬准，滑走了。
lines.en: That bite missed and it slipped away.

lines.zh: 我用整个身子压住它。
lines.en: I press my whole body down on it.

lines.zh: 它甩尾打我的节片，很响。
lines.en: Its tail hits my plates with a hard crack.

lines.zh: 我得手了，退回石缝里吃。
lines.en: I have it; I retreat into the crevice to eat.

lines.zh: 咬不动壳的就换软的咬。
lines.en: If the shell will not give, I bite somewhere soft.

lines.zh: 深海里的打斗都很短。
lines.en: Fights down here are short.

lines.zh: 我从泥里钻出来，节片还是软的。
lines.en: I rise from the mud with soft new plates.

lines.zh: 冷水一下灌满我全身。
lines.en: Cold water floods through me at once.

lines.zh: 我旁边还有一只，一起出来。
lines.en: Another emerges beside me at the same time.

lines.zh: 这里的光很暗，我认得路。
lines.en: The light is dim here, but I know the way.

lines.zh: 我第一次爬过这片礁石。
lines.en: This is my first crawl over this reef.

lines.zh: 我的腿还没站稳，先贴住石头。
lines.en: My legs are unsteady, so I cling to stone.

lines.zh: 泥盖着我，像给我一件外衣。
lines.en: Silt covers me like a borrowed coat.

lines.zh: 海沟往深处去，我跟着走。
lines.en: The trench runs deep and I follow it.

lines.zh: 我现在很小，壳会一层层长。
lines.en: I am small now; my shell will grow in layers.

lines.zh: 我出生在没有太阳的地方。
lines.en: I was born where the sun never reaches.

lines.zh: 火的热透过水烫我节片。
lines.en: Fire's heat reaches through water and scalds my plates.

lines.zh: 我从礁上翻落，壳磕出响。
lines.en: I tumble off the reef and my shell cracks loud.

lines.zh: 我离开水反而要命，喘不上气。
lines.en: Out of water I cannot breathe at all.

lines.zh: 炸开的力把我掀进泥里。
lines.en: The blast drives me down into the silt.

lines.zh: 一根尖刺卡在我节片之间。
lines.en: A spike is wedged between my plates.

lines.zh: 那股力透进壳，我节片发抖。
lines.en: That force passes my shell and my plates tremble.

lines.zh: 我饿到去啃礁石上的苔。
lines.en: Starving, I scrape moss off the reef.

lines.zh: 雷进了水，我全身一麻。
lines.en: Lightning enters the water and numbs me.

lines.zh: 下面没有海底，只有黑。
lines.en: Below there is no floor, only black.
